issue.description:
## GOVERNING PROCESS (Ryan's map, 2026-10-01) -- follow IN ORDER, no skipping, no reordering

 1. Star selected (config/stars.yaml SSOT).
 2. Determine instruments + data holdings for the star (ledgers).
 3. Data audit / preflight per holding (codex-data-audit; measurement_ready).
 4. Continuum + telluric correction, per band, per instrument holding -- done ONCE, then frozen for every element. Raw spectra never used.
 5. All literature on the target star retrieved (litscan).
 6. Secure correct VALD/NIST lines (codex-vald-extraction).
 7. Cross-check vs known solar graded lines (Reference / Codex / Deep grades).
 8. Stellar parameters (pinned from STAR_PARAMS, or solved).
 9. Begin elemental measurements -- IRON FIRST. Fe result sets \[Fe/H\] for every other element.
10. Measure every band, every instrument, every engine (engines never combined).
11. Uncertainty analysis.
12. Check against known literature values.
13. Report any problem lines on the target star's element Linear ticket (

Should invalidate per unit (key each unit dir by its own command + inputs_hash).
